EEG.preprocessing: 1-40 Hz band-pass; 50 Hz line-noise filter; average reference; automatic saving enabled
EEG.feature_extraction: T1; -1 to 2 s; no baseline; all channels and available features

fNIRS.preprocessing: first-order detrending; TDDR; 0.01-0.2 Hz band-pass; participant age 24; automatic saving enabled
fNIRS.feature_extraction: event 1; -2 to 10 s; no baseline; all channels; mean, peak, minimum, AUC, and peak latency

ET.file_description: Private ET recording with an accompanying scene video; files are not distributed
ET.fields: right-eye 2D gaze coordinates and pupil area
ET.preprocessing: 75 ms pupil/gaze interpolation; moving-average filters (5 pupil, 3 gaze); 30 deg/s fixation threshold; 100-300 ms blink threshold; 20 ms velocity window; fixation merge 75 ms/0.5 deg; minimum fixation 60 ms; automatic saving enabled
ET.feature_extraction: all available fixation, saccade, pupil, and blink features
